integrity: Exact finite checks reproducible with verify.py; infinite proofs supplied in RESULT.md. No external independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on eventual termination and dependent on the published exhaustive bounded-seed classification of Ye (2026), which itself uses Szalay's exponential-Diophantine result. Terminal-case stopping times also appear in Sedaghat (2020). This result gives a new exact dyadic census, total stopping-time polynomial and optimal-order conditional convergence rate; it does not classify divergent stopping times or find the exact optimal supremum-rate coefficient. Earlier implicit summations cannot be ruled out completely.
title: Conditional stopping-time law for bounded symmetric quadratic Collatz orbits
